title: 七绝山清果巷
subtitle: 大麻烦，也能分成一小步一小步
origin: 《西游记》第六十七回（低龄温和改编）

moral.zh: 面对又脏又大的难题，先分类、再分工、注意安全，一点点做就能让环境重新清爽。
moral.en: When a messy problem feels huge, sort it, share the work, stay safe, and improve the space one step at a time.

pages.zh: 七绝山盛产甜柿子，可熟果堆满窄巷，车马和村民都过不去。
pages.en: Seven Wonders Mountain grew sweet persimmons, but fallen ripe fruit clogged the narrow lane so carts and villagers could not pass.
pages.prompt: Full Journey to the West team arrives at a sunny ancient village lane gently piled with many ripe orange persimmons and leaves; carts wait safely, no rot horror or text.

pages.zh: 一位红鳞山灵守着果林，担心大家清路时会把树根和小动物的家一起弄坏。
pages.en: A red-scaled mountain spirit guarded the grove, worried that clearing the lane might harm roots and animal homes.
pages.prompt: Friendly Red-Scale Mountain Spirit, a large rounded adult with coral-red and gold soft scales, kind amber eyes, cream belly, teal gardener vest and woven leaf basket, stands protectively beside roots and rabbit homes; no fangs, claws or text.

pages.zh: 唐僧请村民和山灵先画出三块区域：能吃的、能做肥料的、需要清洗处理的。
pages.en: Tang Seng asked villagers and the spirit to mark three areas: edible fruit, compost fruit, and fruit needing cleaning.
pages.prompt: Tang Seng leads a cooperative sorting plan using three large colored mats with simple fruit, leaf and water-drop icons; villagers and friendly red-scaled spirit listen, no readable text.

pages.zh: 悟空把好果装篮，八戒用木耙归拢落叶，沙僧铺防滑草垫，白龙马运空筐。
pages.en: Wukong packed good fruit, Bajie raked leaves, Sha laid non-slip grass mats, and White Dragon Horse carried empty baskets.
pages.prompt: Full team sorts persimmons safely: Wukong fills baskets, Bajie uses rounded rake, Sha lays woven grass mats, White Dragon Horse carries empty side baskets; no text.

pages.zh: 山灵带小动物从树根旁捡出果核，埋进新苗圃，让来年还能长出小树。
pages.en: The spirit and small animals collected seeds near the roots and planted them in a nursery for future trees.
pages.prompt: Friendly red-scaled mountain spirit and small rabbits and birds place persimmon seeds into a neat nursery bed using tiny rounded scoops; warm regenerative scene, no text.

pages.zh: 村民把熟透的果子做成果泥和堆肥，不再把它们重新丢回路中央。
pages.en: Villagers made overripe fruit into puree and compost instead of throwing it back into the lane.
pages.prompt: Village adults use safe covered wooden presses and compost baskets to process ripe persimmons beside clean lane; no open waste, no flies, no text.

pages.zh: 大家从巷口一丈一丈向前清理，每完成一段，就挂上一枚绿色叶牌。
pages.en: They cleared the lane section by section, hanging a green leaf marker after each completed stretch.
pages.prompt: Team, villagers and mountain spirit progress down the lane in organized sections, hanging blank green leaf-shaped markers on posts; visibly cleaner path behind them, no text.

pages.zh: 果巷重新通畅，空气也清新了。山灵送来一篮甜柿子，感谢大家既清路又护林。
pages.en: The lane reopened and the air felt fresh. The spirit shared a basket of sweet persimmons, grateful that the team protected both road and grove.
pages.prompt: Clean sunny village lane, healthy persimmon grove and open passage; friendly red-scaled spirit offers a fruit basket to full team as villagers and animals celebrate gently, no text.
